goal: Prove the future page272-only service-radio server validator without creating a MetForm entry, triggering mail/webhooks or sending an external message.

implementation_requirement.named_callback: The future validator should expose a named project function rather than only an anonymous closure so its pure validation behavior can be invoked directly in a controlled WP-CLI eval.

non_delivery_tests.synthetic_context: Set the same request URI/referer values the callback reads, call the named callback directly with is_valid=true and form_data lacking/empty exact service field.
non_delivery_tests.expected: is_valid=false with the proven project validation message.

non_delivery_tests.synthetic_context: Same page272 route/referer, exact service field populated with one current allowed option value.
non_delivery_tests.expected: incoming valid result remains valid; callback does not alter unrelated form_data.

non_delivery_tests.synthetic_context: Same Form33 route but referer resolves to a different page using the shared form.
non_delivery_tests.expected: result returned byte-for-byte/semantically unchanged; no page272 validation effect.

non_delivery_tests.synthetic_context: Page272 referer but request URI is not the Form33 insert route.
Incoming result already has is_valid=false/message from another validator.
non_delivery_tests.expected: return existing failure unchanged; never overwrite photo-count or other validation messages.

live_readback_after_future_install: ID36 semantic runtime unchanged unless separately updated in its own package
note: This plan deliberately separates validation logic proof from a real REST submission. It can prove callback behavior without testing entry persistence/delivery, which remain excluded by the current user constraints.
